normalization_notes: All proposed IDs are lowercase kebab-case slugs generated from family, archetype, object type, title/name, and artist where applicable.
Source report artist/album/song rows are retained with existing_seed=true.
Expansion and boundary-control rows are marked existing_seed=false.
Recognition, survey, role, and album type values are normalized to the requested enum sets.
Distinct covers, versions, collaborations, traditional attributions, and ambiguous standards are flagged rather than merged.

second_pass_crosscheck.merge_policy: Curated missing-obvious and high-survey-value additions only; collector-depth and unstable boundary suggestions retained as warnings/addendum rather than full import rows.

normalization_updates.change: Normalized song artist_survey_status values to artist_survey_worthy/song_survey_first/song_survey_only enum after Family 1 packet validation.
